items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Rapoport corroborated the downgrade and elevation notes.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 1; missed practices, officially downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; BAL WR room thins to Bateman and backups.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Rashod Bateman, Devontez Walker, others; Mark Andrews TE1 bump.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful (knee); elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White. Will test pregame as GTD.
items.why: Knee injury; limited Friday return after missing earlier practices.
items.implication: Prepare for absence; low-end TE streamers or Michael Mayer.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated role/targets if OUT.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots due to foot injury (LP-DNP-DNP).
items.why: Foot injury; limited then DNP Thursday/Friday, official downgrade Saturday.
items.opportunity: Possible bump to other PIT pass-catchers if any relevant.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) on ETR Sunday injury board and confirmed across reports; missed Thu/Fri practices after Wed injury.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wednesday practice; history of hamstring issues.
items.implication: HOU WR crumbs; remove from all lineups.
items.opportunity: Targets to Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte, Jaylin Noel, Dalton Schultz; cheap WR volume.

items.text: Rams listed WR Puka Nacua questionable (hip/groin soreness) for MNF vs Giants; DNP Fri/Sat. McVay: pregame decision, different from camp issue. Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Hip/groin soreness after Thursday practice; smart management, McVay notes not full speed.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; high-upside if active.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TE usage (Higbee etc.) and secondary WRs rise; reverse if IN.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but expected to play; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson. Coach/Taylor positive, Burrow himself dismissive of missing.
items.why: Back issue; full or positive practice signals and public comments.
items.implication: Start with confidence but confirm inactives; CIN offense intact.
items.opportunity: Full volume for Chase/Higgins/Brown if active as expected.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects so many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. Will update immediately on news.
items.why: Ribs limit routes/contested catches; central to LAC offense and Herbert's efficiency.
items.implication: Herbert/LAC pass catchers projections swing hard on status; monitor closely.
items.opportunity: QJ/Harris volume if sits; Herbert ceiling if plays.

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (ribs) on ETR board; limited Friday after missing earlier. Biggest slate injury per Levitan.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; returned limited Friday.
items.implication: Monitor inactives; affects Herbert and LAC pass game heavily.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris target spikes in good matchup.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN (cleared, full participant, no designation) for debut vs Steelers after ankle; ready to go.
items.why: Ankle injury resolved; full practices, self-declared ready.
items.implication: Monitor snap/touch share vs Stevenson in NE desperate for playmakers (AJ Brown IR).
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential as explosive change-of-pace; flex upside, nice upcoming schedule.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers (AJ Brown IR); do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in 2026 debut? Unclear vs Stevenson but returning at right time with strong upcoming schedule.
items.why: Explosive profile, NE need after poor Week 1 run game, Brown absence, favorable stretch before bye.
items.implication: Flex consideration with upside; Stevenson still likely lead but share expands.
items.opportunity: 10+ touches, big-play potential, third-down growth possible.

items.text: If Zay Flowers can't go (now OUT), Ravens WRs: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. BAL/HOU/NE down to crumbs at WR. CMC bump off Week 1 usage; Kaelon Black (groin) status matters.
items.why: Flowers/Lane absences force hierarchy; CMC usage already strong, Black competition limited.
items.implication: Start Bateman-type in deeper; CMC strong RB1 regardless.
items.opportunity: Bateman routes/targets spike; CMC volume secure.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker (vs IND): 74% snaps, 40% routes targeted, tied team lead targets Week 1; Indy gave up big to Henry. LOVE Ashton Jeanty (99 util, 19% tgt share). LOVE Bucky Irving (26% tgt, all RB RZ touches).
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization/target/RZ shares + favorable matchups (IND weak run D, etc.).
items.implication: Strong starts; Walker high-end RB1 potential this week.

items.text: LOVE Dak Prescott (vs WAS): home PPG, WAS torched Week 1, high totals. LOVE Justin Jefferson (@CHI): 37% share from Wentz, career success with him. LOVE DeVonta Smith (@TEN): 27% share, high aDOT, TEN weak vs WR. Also Evans, Kincaid.
items.why: Matchup + usage data (target share, aDOT, historical with QB, defense weaknesses).
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency in positive game scripts.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne (@BAL): matched Miller rushes Week 1, air-heavy fantasy, Kamara expected back squeezes role further; bad script as underdogs. HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. (vs SEA): 8% target share, zero RZ, SEA tough on WRs.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara IN + poor Week 1 split; MHJ low share vs strong pass D.
items.opportunity: Kamara return reduces Etienne; MHJ volatile low-floor.
